referee_caveats_inferred: Absorption features are only 3.0-3.5 sigma, so the high-velocity infall claim rests on marginal detections
Beam smearing versus turbulence is not decisively separated; the 3DBarolo test is a two-model toy with an assumed emissivity
Hard cut at 1200 klambda removes large-scale flux and imprints negative bowls that can bias moment and line-ratio maps
Temperature and column densities rely on LTE, an assumed HCO+ abundance and a 300 K excitation with no uncertainties
Orbit models are chosen by eye with no fit statistics
Continuum peak offset of ~25 mas is attributed to phase-referencing and then removed by hand

reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Likely 100-300 GB raw for three long-baseline Band 7 observing blocks (estimate); averaged working data far smaller
reproducibility.score_reason: Project code and key imaging settings (robust 2.0, 2.5 mas, 1200 klambda cut, self-cal 40 s) are given and numeric results are partly reported, but masks, thresholds, line-free channels, cube rms and the modelling code are not stated.
